## Build system
Maven (no Gradle). `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml` + wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`.
- Build/test everything: `./mvnw test` (or `./mvnw verify`) from `/home/daniel/sandbox`.
- Run just the acceptance test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`.
- Note: `OwnerDto` is code-generated at build time by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` (v7.23.0) from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, and MapStruct (v1.6.3) generates the mapper impl. So changes to response fields start in `openapi.yml`, not in a hand-written DTO.

## 1. The hard 50-per-city rejection (service/controller logic)
File: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`

The limit constant (line 96):
```java
96    private static final int MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 50;
```
The check method (lines 685-694), called from `addOwner` at line 189:
```java
685    private void rejectCityAtCapacity(String city) {
686        long ownersInCity = this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
687            .map(Owner::getCity)
688            .filter(Objects::nonNull)
689            .filter(city::equalsIgnoreCase)
690            .count();
691        if (ownersInCity >= MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY) {
692            throw new OwnerCityAtCapacityException(city);
693        }
694    }
```

```java
189        rejectCityAtCapacity(ownerFieldsDto.getCity());
```

Note: there is no repository count-by-city method — the count is done in-memory by streaming `clinicService.findAllOwners()`. This is the same pattern used for the sibling rules (`countRegisteredOn` line 760, `countNamesakes` line 536).

## 2. The exception (rendered as 409)
File: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/OwnerCityAtCapacityException.java` (whole file, 50 lines). Carries the city and detail message "The owner's city has reached its maximum number of owners"; handled by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`.

## 3. The `capacityWarning` field — does NOT exist yet
This is the key finding. `capacityWarning` appears ONLY in the test file, never in production code:
```
/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java:18: getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.capacityWarning").value(true));
```

- OpenAPI schema (source of `OwnerDto`): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2298-2305:
```yaml
2298            bulkSignupWarning:

2302                registration date at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
2303              type: boolean
```

(A `capacityWarning` schema would be added alongside here.)

- Model field: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` line 74-75 (`@Column(name = "bulk_signup_warning") private Boolean bulkSignupWarning;`), getter/setter at lines 184-189.

- Stamped in the controller during `addOwner`: line 199
```java
199        owner.setBulkSignupWarning(registeredThatDay > BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD);
```
with the threshold constant at line 110 (`BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 80`).

- Mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — `bulkSignupWarning` is mapped implicitly by MapStruct (same field name on `Owner` and `OwnerDto`), so no explicit `@Mapping` line is needed. A new `capacityWarning` would map the same way if added to both the model and the DTO/openapi schema.

So implementing `capacityWarning` would mirror `bulkSignupWarning`: add the schema field in `openapi.yml`, a `capacityWarning` column/getter/setter on `Owner.java`, and a `owner.setCapacityWarning(...)` call in `addOwner` (true when the city holds 40-49 owners, i.e. `>= 40 && < 50`).

## 4. Repository
File: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java` — interface with `findAll()` (line 74), `findById`, `save`, etc. There is NO `countByCity` method. Implementations: `jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java`. Capacity counting is done in the controller via streams, not in the repository.

It is `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional`, authed as an `OWNER_ADMIN`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured fields are supplied it is derived
            from them. On output it is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address'. An owner is valid
            when it supplies an address in either form: a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or suite). When present it is normalized and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits. The stored value must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's region
            ('Sydney' -> NSW 2000-2099, 'Melbourne' -> VIC 3000-3099, 'Brisbane' ->
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            A postcode that is malformed or out of range for the city's region is
            rejected with a 400. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS or
            DR). When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time directive. When true, the owner is permitted to
            share a household with an existing owner, so the create request is not
            rejected as a household duplicate even when another owner has the same
            last name and postcode. A declared household member is created and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the honorific 'title' and the
                'lastName' separated by a single space when a title is present, or
                just the 'lastName' when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' is presented as '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                field keeps its canonical E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), derived by preferring the postcode: a 4-digit
                postcode within a known region's range ('NSW' 2000-2099, 'VIC' 3000-3099,
                'QLD' 4000-4099) yields that region. When the postcode is absent or in no known
                range, it falls back to a fixed city-to-region table ('Sydney' -> 'NSW',
                'Melbourne' -> 'VIC', 'Brisbane' -> 'QLD'). A city not in the table with no
                region-bearing postcode derives the locality 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality (region) via a fixed
                region-to-timezone table ('NSW' -> 'Australia/Sydney', 'VIC' -> 'Australia/Melbourne',
                'QLD' -> 'Australia/Brisbane'). A region not in the table derives no timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at the
                time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar
                year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next
                calendar year's fiscal year; YY is the last two digits of that year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (see 'fiscalYear').
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household - those with
                the same last name (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) and
                postcode. It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized
                last name and postcode joined with '|', so owners with the same last name and
                postcode derive it automatically. A second owner in the same household is
                rejected as a duplicate unless it opts in with 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed by joining the normalized
                telephone, the email (or an empty string when absent) and the householdId with
                '|' separators (normalizedTelephone + '|' + email + '|' + householdId). A create
                is rejected as a duplicate only when this whole key equals that of an existing
                owner.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created, sharing the
                same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, computed on creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for
                a household of 3 or more; add 3 when at least one fiscal year has elapsed
                since registrationDate (measured from registrationDate to today, counting
                1-July boundaries crossed).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration date at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the presence of an
                email: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no 'birthDate' is given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's
                last name and postcode while carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on last name and postcode,
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

I implemented the `capacityWarning` flag on owner creation, mirroring the existing `bulkSignupWarning` feature end-to-end.

**Behavior:** When an owner is created and their city already holds **40–49** owners, the created owner's `capacityWarning` is `true`; otherwise `false`. **Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `capacityWarning` boolean schema field to the `Owner` model (this is what generates the `OwnerDto` field at build time).

   - In `addOwner`, set `owner.setCapacityWarning(ownersInCity >= CAPACITY_WARNING_THRESHOLD)`.
